testcase.name: Scenario: loft-15 Cancel a failed Closed Loop edit on the fixture: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/solid-model/loft/loft.feature:155:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: loft-15 Cancel a failed Closed Loop edit on the fixture ✔ Given a disposable copy of the native fixture "fixtures/cad/loft/circles-center-line-20.opd" is open ✔ And the user creates Loft1 from the two circular profiles and the 20 mm center line ✔ And the user edits Loft1, selects placed-sections mode, adds an intermediate section near the center-line midpoint and accepts it with alternate section size 1 ✔ And Loft1 is reopened for editing ✔ When the user enables Closed Loop and accepts the edit ✔ Then the MCAD Software reports that the loft feature edit failed ✔ When the user cancels the failure dialog ✔ Then the previously accepted solid is visible again
